rubric_items.reason: Uses the existing route/service/repository layers, client.ts and format.ts. Adds no migration, endpoint, job or infrastructure. Every component sits on an existing module (api, web, db).
Maps S-1 to S-4 to components. Every AC is covered: COMPLETED filter, null renders '-', paging/sort/search/Next appointment left alone, no new patient columns selected.

The endpoint, field name, type (string|null) and envelope are precise. Gaps: the formatter is named only loosely ('date'), 'subquery (or LATERAL)' is left open, and the web's source for the hospital time zone is not given.
Claims are cited, and U-1/Q-01 are carried forward honestly. No fact backs the assumption that the web knows HOSPITAL_TZ or that Next appointment is formatted with dateTime in the hospital time zone.
Explains the three non-obvious choices: client-side TZ formatting, a correlated subquery instead of a materialised column, and filtering in SQL instead of the UI.
Clear and consistent between front matter and body. One awkward claim wording (C15), and claim C12 (todayIn) is never used in the body.

findings.text: The design has web format last_visit_at 'in the hospital time zone', but HOSPITAL_TZ is only documented as API config. No cited fact shows how the web gets the zone, or that dateTime/Next appointment already uses it. This leaves REQ-3/REQ-4 (S-1 AC3/AC4) resting on an unstated assumption.

cites.quote: without the time part), formatted in the hospital time zone

findings.suggested_fix: Cite the web source of the zone (for example the todayIn signature or a web config fact) and the dateTime behaviour. If none exists, add an Assumed/Unknown item and a question for the tech lead.

findings.text: appointment_patient_start_idx covers (patient_id, starts_at), not status. So the COMPLETED lookup walks each patient's appointments by starts_at DESC until it finds one, not one index probe per row. Also, 'subquery (or LATERAL)' leaves the query shape undecided.

cites.quote: computed with a correlated subquery (or LATERAL) on `appointment`

findings.suggested_fix: Pick one query form and note in the trade-offs that status is filtered after the index range scan.

findings.text: Claim C15 wording is garbled ('No new `New SQL files`'). Claim C12 (todayIn) is declared but never used in the design body.

cites.quote: No new `New SQL files` are needed

findings.suggested_fix: Reword C15 to 'No migration is needed'. Either use todayIn to support the time-zone path (see F-1) or drop C12.

cites.quote:
services hold the rules and
transactions, repositories hold the SQL
The web app talks to the API only through `web/src/api/client.ts`.
Lists answer `{ items, page, page_size, total }`, 20 per page.
never request bodies, contact details or medical
New SQL files only, never edits to merged ones.

questions.text: How does the web app know the hospital time zone (Asia/Kolkata) when it formats dates? Does dateTime, as used by the Next appointment column, already format in that zone?
